client_query_id.description: Names the ClickHouse query this request runs. Send the same id to `DELETE /api/projects/:project_id/query/:client_query_id/` to stop a search that is still running. Up to 128 characters.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

search.description: Search persons by email, name, person ID, or distinct ID. Partial values match. A UUID that exactly matches a person ID or distinct ID returns only the persons it matches. A complete email address that exactly matches a distinct ID returns that person first, then every person whose email or name property contains the address. Each result carries `matched_fields`, the searched fields the term was found in.
